items.headline: 封鎖戰術會複製到台灣？
items.context: 台灣長年準備因應中國可能的軍事行動，伊朗與烏克蘭這兩場戰爭，讓外界開始討論新的威脅型態。有分析認為，中國可能觀察伊朗在荷莫茲海峽的封鎖手法，思考未來是否對台灣海峽採取類似做法。這仍是分析角度的觀察，並非已經證實的軍事計畫。

sources.summary: Assembly Hall, Edinburgh Can you dance flamenco to Eye of the Tiger? Of course, says the company Yllana, in a flamboyant celebration of breaking down barriers You don’t need to know anything about flamenco to enjoy Flamenc Oh!! That overuse of exclamation marks gives you an idea of the subtlety of this fun/silly dance-comedy by Spanish company Yllana , based on flamenco’s battle between tradition and modernity (which is a real thing in the flamenco world, with its division between purists and progressives). Here is our patriarch with his straight spine and authoritarian streak, banning all music other than flamenco from his family. There’s mother and daughter in polka dots and frills, the son forever trying (and failing) to impress his dad, and their hunk of a cousin who has returned from his travels with some new guitar chords and a love of the blues, ready to upset the status quo.
